Sentences and Transformations.question: ১)  The negating form of 'Every mother loves her child.' is-
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) There is no mother but loves her child.
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) Every mother cannot but loves her child.
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) No mother loves her child.
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) There is no mother loving her child.
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
• Every কে negative করতে হলে Every এর পরিবর্তে প্রথমে There is no + Every এর পরের শব্দটি বসে + but বসে + বাক্যের বাকি অংশ বসে।
- অথবা, who ব্যবহার করা যায়। কিন্তু who এ পরে does not বসে।
যথা :
• Affirmative: Every mother loves her child.
- Negative: There is no mother who does not love her child.
- Negative: There is no mother but loves her child.

• অনেক সময় Every এর পরিবর্তে no বসে এবং বাক্যস্থিত affirmative শব্দটির negative রূপ বসিয়েও বাক্যটিকে negative করা যায়।
- যেমন :
Affirmative: Every mother loves her child.
Negative: No mother hates her child.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ২) ‘May Allah help you'. What type of sentence is this?
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) Optative
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) Imperative
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) Assertive
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) Exclamatory
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
• 'May Allah help you. - is an optative sentence.

• Optative Sentence:
- ইচ্ছা বা প্রার্থনা বুঝালে Optative Sentence বলে।
- বাক্য গঠন করার সহজ নিয়ম হল: May + Assertive = Optative sentence গঠিত হয়।
Example:
তোমরা দীর্ঘজীবী হও = May you live long. ('may' verb টি উহ্য আছে)।
ভগবান তোমাদের আশীর্বাদ করুক = May God bless you.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ৩) The exclamatory form of the sentence: I wish I had seen you before.
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) Wow! I seen you before.
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) Oh! I seen you before.
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) Had I seen you before!
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) If I seen you before.
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
• Assertive Sentence থেকে Exclamatory Sentence রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
→ I wish থাকলে এর পরিবর্তে had, could, if, would দ্বারা বাক্য শুরু হয়।
→ বাক্যের শেষে Exclamation sign (!) বসবে।

Example:
Assertive Sentence: I wish I had passed the NTRCA exam.
Exclamatory Sentence: Had I passed the NTRCA exam!

Assertive Sentence: I wish I had seen you before.
Exclamatory Sentence: Had I seen you before!

Sentences and Transformations.question: ৪) Active voice of 'Rome was not built in a day'-
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) The Romans did not build Rome in a day.
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) People were not build Rome in a day.
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) The Romans were not build Rome in a day.
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) Romans does not build Rome in a day.
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
• Passive Voice এ যদি by + Object না থাকে এবং verb টি যদি পেশা বা নির্দিষ্ট ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুর সাথে Related কাজ হয় তাহলে ঐ পেশাজীবী বা ঐ নির্দিষ্ট ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুর নাম Subject হিসেবে বসাতে হবে।

• Rome was not built in a day.
- এখানে subject ‘Rome’ কিন্তু object দেয়া নেই বা object টা এখানে উহ্য আছে।
- Rome সাম্রাজ্য যেহেতু Roman রা তৈরি করেছে, তাই active করার সময় subject হিসেবে The Romans ব্যবহার করতে হবে।

• নিয়মানুযায়ী,
• Rome was not built in a day.
- The Romans did not build Rome in a day.

• Other examples:
• He was born in 1960.
- His mother bore him in 1960.

• Water was irrigated.
- Farmers irrigated water.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ৫) Change the voice - 'Where did you see him?'
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) Where did he seen by you?
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) Where was he seen by you?
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) where was he see by you?
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) Where was seen by you?
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
• উক্ত বাক্যটিতে past indefinite tense ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।
- past indefinite tense কে passive form করতে হলে
- was/were + verb এর past participle হবে।
- Whom এর পরিবর্তে প্রথমে Who হবে।

Active: Where did you see him?
Passive:  Where was he seen by you?

Sentences and Transformations.question: ৬) Which one is an example of superlative degree?
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) little
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) least
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) less
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) near
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
Least হলো superlative degree’র উদাহরণ।
এর comparative degree হলো less.
যার মূল Adjective টি হলো little.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ৭) He is taller than ___ .
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) me
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) myself
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) I
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) am I
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
'Than I' or 'Than Me':
• Be verb (am, is, are, was, were, be, being, been) এর পর pronoun আসলে ঐ pronoun টি subjective form (I/ we/he/she) হবে।
• as, if, than এদের পর Subjective Pronoun বসে। Subjective Pronoun: I, We, She He, It, They.
• verb এর subject হিসেবে বসে।
• নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর হবে- He is taller than I.

উল্লেখ্য যে, 'than' শব্দটি preposition এবং conjunction উভয় হিসেবেই ব্যবহৃত হতে পারে।
• preposition হিসেবে ধরে নিলে উত্তর হবে me আর conjunction হিসেবে ধরে নিলে উত্তর হবে 'I', যার পরে am উহ্য আছে।
• Preposition: John likes Peter more than me.
• Conjunction: John is taller than I am. Or John is taller than I. (This is just a more succinct version.)

Source: Merriam-Webster Dictionary.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ৮) ‘Ten years have passed since his father died’. Make it simple.
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) His father has died ten years ago
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) His father died since ten years
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) His father has died for ten years
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) His father died ten years ago
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
1) Any Present + since (সময় বুঝাতে) + Past Indefinite
Example:
- It is ten years since his father died.
- Ten years have passed since his father died.

2) Past + since + Past Perfect
Example:
- It was ten years since his father had died.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ৯) ___ scoring the highest marks in the class, Rohit failed to impress his teacher.
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) Even though
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) Besides
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) Despite
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) Nonetheless
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
Despite and in spite are similar in meaning but despite will be used here because in spite is used with of.
Though হলো একটি conjunction যেটি clause এর পূর্বে বসে, despite একটি preposition যেটি noun এর পূর্বে বসে। So, Even though is incorrect.
With respect to means regards to or reference to which is incorrect for the sentence.

সঠিক বাক্য: Despite scoring the highest marks in the class, Rohit failed to impress his teacher.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ১০) What is the simple sentence of 'He is so dishonest that he cannot speak the truth.'-
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) He is too dishonest that he cannot speak the truth.
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) He is too dishonest to be spoken the truth.
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) He is too dishonest to speak the truth.
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) He is very dishonest and cannot speak the truth.
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
• Complex sentence এ যদি so + adjective + that + subject + cannot/could not + verb থাকে,
- সেক্ষেত্রে simple sentence এ too + adjective + to + verb এর base form বসে।

সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর - He is too dishonest to speak the truth.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ১১) Do whatever you like. This is an example of-
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) Simple sentence
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) Compound sentence
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) Multiple sentence
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) Complex sentence
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
• Complex sentence:
- যে sentence এ একটি Principal clause এবং এক বা একাধিক Subordinate clause থাকে, তাকে Complex sentence বলে।
- Complex sentence এর subordinate clause এর শুরুতে সাধারণত if, though, although, as, because, since, so that, that, until, till, unless, when, why, who, which, where, how, before, after, whether, while বসে।

সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী Complex sentence - Do whatever you like.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ১২) What is the complex sentence of 'Read to learn.'-
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) By reading, you will learn.
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) Read and learn.
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) If you read, you will learn.
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) ln case of failure to read, you will not learn.
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
• Complex sentence:
- যে sentence এ একটি Principal clause এবং এক বা একাধিক Subordinate clause থাকে, তাকে Complex sentence বলে।
- Complex sentence এর subordinate clause এর শুরুতে সাধারণত if, though, although, as, because, since, so that, that, until, till, unless, when, why, who, which, where, how, before, after, whether, while বসে।

তাই নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর - If you read, you will learn.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ১৩) ‘It cannot be done’. The active voice form is-
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) No one can done it
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) No one can do it.
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) Most people cannot do it
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) It is impossible to do it
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
• Object ছাড়া passive voice এর বাক্যকে active করার ক্ষেত্রে সুবিধাজনক একটি subject ধরে নিয়ে করতে হয়
- এ ধরনের object বিহীন বাক্যগুলোকে acive করার সময় কাল্পনিক subject (no one, we, I, they) ব্যবহার করতে হয়।
- এরপর Let বাদ যাবে,
- be done এর active form - do বসবে।

• নিয়মানুযায়ী -
Active: It cannot be done.
Passive: No one can do it.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ১৪) Prices for bicycles can run ___ TK. 2000.
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) as high as
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) as high to
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) so high as
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) as high for
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
• Go as low/high as;
Meaning: (মূল্য) নির্দিষ্ট দাম পর্যন্ত যাওয়া।

Example:
Prices for bicycles can run as high as TK. 2,000.
Meaning: বাইসাইকেলের দাম নির্দিষ্ট ২০০০ টাকা পর্যন্ত যেতে পারে।

So 'as high as' form will be correct according to grammar.

• Complete sentence: Prices for bicycles can run as high as TK. 2000.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ১৫) ‘May our cricket team win the World Cup'. Change into an assertive sentence.
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) I wish our cricket team to win the World Cup
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) I wish that our cricket team wins the World Cup
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) I wish our cricket team could win the World Cup
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) I wish our cricket team can win the World Cup
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
Assertive Sentence (বর্ণনামূলক বাক্য):
- যে Sentence দ্বারা কোন কিছুর বর্ননা বা বিবৃতি প্রকাশ করে তাকে Assertive sentence বলে।
- An assertive sentence is a simple statement or assertion, and it may be affirmative or negative.
- structure: “subject + verb + object/complement/adverb”.

Correct Sentence - I wish our cricket team could win the World Cup.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ১৬) He is too weak ___ .
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) to working
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) working
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) for work
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) to work
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
• Too…..to এই গঠন ব্যবহার হয় 'এতই যে ...... না' অর্থ প্রদান করার জন্য।
- এখানে too weak ব্যবহারে ‘ভীষন অসুস্থ’ এই অর্থ প্রকাশ পাচ্ছে।

যেমন:
- He is too weak to work.
- English language is not too difficult to understand.
- The weather is too cold for them to go out.
- Don't worry. English Grammar is not too difficult to understand.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ১৭) Correct passive form of 'My teacher embodies all the good qualities.'-
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) All the good qualities are embodied by my teacher
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) All the good qualities are embodied in my teacher
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) All the good qualities are embodied to my teacher
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) All the good qualities are embodied on my teacher
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
• সাধারণত আমরা জানি passive voice এ object এর পূর্বে by বসে।
- তবে কখনো কখনো অন্যান্য preposition ও ব্যবহৃত হয়ে থাকে।
- কিছু verb আছে যেগুলোর পরে passive এ in বসে।
- যেমন: Embody, Contain, Include ইত্যাদি।

সুতরাং উত্তর হলো - All the good qualities are embodied in my teacher.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ১৮) Passive form of 'He pleases us.'-
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) We were pleased him
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) We are pleased by him
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) We are pleased with him
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) We will be pleased by him
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
• Active voice কে Passive voice এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Active Voice এর object‌ টি Passive voice এর subject হয় + Tense অনুযায়ী Auxiliary verb + মূল verb এর past participle + Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এর object হয় এবং তার পূর্বে Preposition (By, with, at, to,in) বসে।

• ব্যক্তির ক্ষেত্রে with বসে আর ব্যক্তির কাজ বা বস্তুর উপরে সন্তুষ্টি বোঝাতে at বসে।
- যেহেতু প্রশ্নে ব্যক্তির কাজের উপর সন্তুষ্টি বোঝানো হয়েছে তাই pleased at বসবে।

অতএব বাক্যটির সঠিক passive form: We are pleased with him.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ১৯) The passive form of the sentence 'Do not open the door' is-
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) Let not the door be opened
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) Let not the door open
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) Let not the door be open
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) Let not the door opened
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
Do not যুক্ত imperative বাক্যেকে passive করার নিয়ম হচ্ছে:
- প্রথমে let not বসবে।
- এরপর object বসবে।
- be বসবে
- এরপর verb এর past participle বসবে।
Structure: Let not + object + be + V3.

সুতরাং, প্রশ্নোল্লিখিত বাক্যের সঠিক passive form হবে - Let not the door be opened.

Sentences and Transformations.question: ২০) Identify the correctly transformed of 'The mangoes are too cheap to be good.'-
Sentences and Transformations.option1: ক) The mangoes are very cheap, so they are not good.
Sentences and Transformations.option2: খ) The mangoes being cheap cannot be good
Sentences and Transformations.option3: গ) The mangoes are so cheap that they cannot be good
Sentences and Transformations.option4: ঘ) As the mangoes are cheap they are not good
Sentences and Transformations.exp:
• So that যুক্ত complex sentence গুলোতে সাধারণত can, could, may, might ইত্যাদি বসে। 
- প্রথম cluse এ present থাকলে so that এর পরে may/can ইত্যাদি বসে,
- past tense - এ থাকলে, তাই so that এর পরে can এর past form might/could বসে। 

Simple Sentence এ Present Tense এ too … to থাকলে, Complex Sentence এ so …. that + sub + can + not + verb-এর base form বসে।
অর্থাৎ, সঠিক বক্যটি হবে - The mangoes are so cheap that they cannot be good.
